dex.entry: A large, crepuscular moth whose wingspan fills a doorway. Its wings are so saturated with null-dust that they absorb the ambient glow from nearby kin, leaving a sphere of unnatural dark around it. An apex predator of light. A moth that eats light itself — awe-inducing at the right stage of the game.

art.silhouette: Huge moth, wings deep charcoal edged in ghostly silver-white trim; six dead-lantern symbols across both wings; a feathered thorax like a burial shroud; compound eyes a milky, sightless grey.
